create_glm4v_image_processor: create a Glm4vImageProcessorPil instance for preprocessing images for the GLM-4.1V multimodal model
run_smart_resize: run smart_resize to compute resized height and width for video frames respecting min/max pixel constraints
get_number_of_image_patches: get the number of image patches for a given image height and width using the GLM-4.1V patch configuration
preprocess_glm4v_images: preprocess PIL images for GLM-4.1V by resizing, rescaling, normalizing, and computing pixel values with grid dimensions
build_glm4v_kwargs: build Glm4vImageProcessorKwargs with patch_size, temporal_patch_size, and merge_size configuration options
